program.name: Field Day
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Bounds and skips, hip-driven lifting and single-leg stability for running and field sports.
program.about: Training for the field: running, cutting and change of direction. The sprint day opens with bounds and power skips, the power day with jumps and explosive push-ups, and the stability day with single-leg hops. Lifting is hip-driven, with hinges, glute work and swings, and every day has balance drills that make one-leg strength stick. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps, and the jumps get harder variations at Level III.
program.gear: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell.
